purpose: Compare five preregistered NIFTY setup families and their fixed-priority first-daily union against matched rule-only ORB; no training or activation

signal_rules.common: First signal per complete day only, 09:45<=signal bar start<14:30 IST; >=75 verified regular spot bars and >=90% exact-timestamp verified front-future coverage; current bar closed; ATR>0. No replacement after missing/ineligible first signal.
signal_rules.ORB_CONTROL: Spot close outside 09:15-09:35 opening high/low; matching front-future vs VWAP and EMA9 vs EMA20.
signal_rules.ROLLING_30M: Spot close beyond previous six same-day five-minute highs/lows, excluding current bar; matching front-future VWAP side and EMA9/EMA20 trend.
signal_rules.VWAP_PULLBACK: Existing causal pullback geometry with EMA9/20/50 alignment, wick/previous-close touch, same-side futures VWAP, RSI 45..72 CE or 28..55 PE.
signal_rules.RANGE_REJECTION: Current bar touches opening-range edge but closes back inside with reversal candle body and confirming futures VWAP side.
signal_rules.VWAP_REVERSION: Previous close more than one ATR beyond previous spot VWAP, current bar reverses toward VWAP while still beyond it; RSI<=45 CE or >=55 PE.
signal_rules.GAP_FADE: Opening gap magnitude >0.5 current ATR; first bar reverses toward prior close while gap remains open, with futures VWAP confirmation.
signal_rules.FIVE_SETUP_FIRST: Earliest of five alternative first signals per day; ties resolved by frozen priority above, without looking at outcome.

contract_selection: Earliest eligible non-expiry-day metadata-verified option expiry; ATM then ITM1; choose first with verified positive-volume exact signal candle; no substitution after chosen next-bar path is absent.
entry_exit: One whole lot at next exact five-minute option open +0.05% slippage; signal-close underlying stop one ATR and target 1.5 ATR; premium emergency stop25%; square-off15:20 IST; contiguous option/spot bars; conservative stop-first same bar; actual Groww fee formula in app/risk.py. Double-slippage replay uses 0.10% per side.
risk: Research capital INR100000, max one first signal/day, one whole lot cash+estimated-fee affordability, <=5% capital premium-stop risk, saved7% daily loss immaterial with one trade/day. Unknown first outcomes retained. No oversizing.
comparison: All arms use same eligible sessions, costs, timeframe and exit rules; paired calendar-day difference of fixed five-setup union vs rule-only ORB with 2000 day-bootstrap draws seed42; unknown paired days reported and not replaced.
acceptance: On exposed2026: >=100 completed first-daily selected trades, >=99% selected and ORB coverage, >70% net wins, PF>=1.3, positive net and double-slippage P&L with >=99% stress coverage, drawdown<=INR10000, >=60% positive active months across >=6 active months, paired bootstrap lower95>0. Even all gates cannot establish live readiness because history is exposed and OHLC not executable quotes.
limitations: All historic years have been inspected; not a fresh final test
No historical bid/ask, quote freshness, delta, IV or exact live option selection
November4 observed market inspired family choice and is excluded
Matched ORB control is rule-only in same hours, not selected model9
No model/threshold/regime router trained or activated; no live or shadow order
